# Connect Bhai

> Connect Bhai is a broadband marketplace for Madhya Pradesh, live in Indore (also serving Depalpur, Mhow and Sanwer). Enter a PIN code, compare BSNL, Jio, Airtel and local ISP fiber, SIM, TV and OTT plans, request a connection and get Connect Bhai Care for router and Wi-Fi help. Tagline: Compare. Choose. Connect. Care.

Office: 215-A, Mahalaxmi Nagar, Indore (M.P.) 452010. Support: call or WhatsApp +91 94799 35365, open daily 08:00 to 18:00.

## Who uses it

- Customer: compares plans by PIN code, requests a connection, tracks the installation and uses the Care plan.
- DSA (agent): brings and works customer leads in assigned PIN codes, then books the connection.
- TIP (installer partner): installs the booked connection at the customer's address.

## Notes for AI tools

- Dashboards (/my, /dsa, /tip, /admin) need a login and are not for crawling.
- Plans and prices are set by the providers and can change. Check the site for current plans in your area.
